title: RebuildHostWall Command
description: Re-extrude one Forsk wall from its forsk:path record and recut that wall's openings from forsk:t, forsk:offset, width, sill, head, and kind. The wall GUID stays. Floor, roof, rooms, other walls, drawings, and layouts stay. Id omitted uses the current selection: one wall, or one opening marker or frame. A wall with no forsk:path refuses. An X-EXIST host refuses.

id.description: Wall GUID, or an opening marker or frame GUID. Omit to use the current selection.
